seo_title: ClearOrigin — EUDR traceability & compliance, from plot to importer
seo_description: Plot geolocation, legality documents, satellite deforestation analysis (WHISP/FAO): ClearOrigin automates EUDR due diligence for timber, coffee, cocoa and 4 more commodities.

body.headline: Prove your EUDR compliance, from plot to importer
body.subheadline: ClearOrigin brings together plot geolocation, legality documents and satellite deforestation analysis — so every batch of timber, coffee, cocoa or rubber enters Europe with complete due diligence.
body.image_caption: Importer view — decision, traceability, deforestation risk

body.title: Due diligence shouldn't be a full-time job
body.intro: Since 30 December 2025, every batch imported into the EU must prove it doesn't come from deforested land. Without a dedicated tool, that means spreadsheets, lost scans and weeks of delay on every shipment.

items.title: Geolocated plots, not declarations on trust
items.text: Every plot is a GPS polygon drawn on a satellite map, linked to its producer and its legality documents.

items.title: Deforestation analysis on autopilot
items.text: Every time a batch is created, the FAO's WHISP tool assesses the deforestation risk of each plot. Standardised result: Low, Medium, High.

items.title: A documentation workload cut down to size
items.text: Legality grids per country and product tell you exactly which documents to collect — with their status at a glance.

items.title: A chain with no missing link
items.text: Producers without a smartphone? Your cooperative represents them in the tool. Traceability stays complete, from field to port.

items.title: Geolocate the plots
items.text: The producer draws their plots on a satellite basemap from their phone — or the cooperative does it for them.

items.title: Collect the legality documents
items.text: Photos taken in the field, up to 10 files per document, validity tracking — guided by the legality grid for your country and product.

items.title: Create the batch — the analysis starts on its own
items.text: WHISP (FAO) automatically assesses every plot in the batch and freezes an immutable, timestamped, defensible deforestation audit.

items.title: Share the proof with the importer
items.text: A public link and a QR code give your European client the full picture: map, supply chain, documents, risk level. No account needed.

items.question: My producers don't have smartphones. Is that a blocker?
items.answer: No. Your cooperative creates “represented” producers and enters their plots, documents and batches on their behalf. The traceability chain stays complete.

items.question: Where does the deforestation analysis come from?
items.answer: From WHISP, the FAO's analysis tool: every plot polygon is assessed and the result is standardised into risk levels (Low, Medium, High). The analysis runs automatically when the batch is created.

items.question: Does my importing client need to create an account?
items.answer: No. They receive a public link (or scan a QR code) and view the batch's full traceability in read-only mode: map, documents, risk levels.

items.question: Which commodities are covered?
items.answer: The seven EUDR commodities: timber, coffee, cocoa, rubber, palm oil, cattle and soy.

items.question: Which languages is the platform available in?
items.answer: French, English, Spanish and Portuguese — so every link in the chain works in its own language.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Request a demo: we walk through your supply chain together and set up your workspace. Your first traced batch can ship that same week.
